alternatives.argument: The item is an explicit definition: it identifies angular L2 with interval L2 and defines H^2_per by matching the continuous endpoint traces of f and f'. The local interval Sobolev and trace suppliers provide the stated representatives; no theorem from Teschl is imported.

The proof is local and complete. Step 1 decomposes the shifted form norm into the L2 norms of every covariant derivative, sqrt(V+v0)u and u. For a form-Cauchy sequence tending to zero in L2, Step 2 tests the derivative limits against the smooth core using the imported magnetic derivative convention and symmetry, and tests the potential component against sqrt(V+v0) times a test function. Density makes every limit zero. Step 3 applies the exact closability criterion and identifies the injective completion and lower bound. No Teschl assertion is used.
